name: Zipz (Garden City, UT) Golden Fried Halibut Fish Sandwich (Tartar on Side)
whyItWorks: Pacific halibut is lean, tender, and easily absorbed. Served on a soft bun with tartar sauce on the side for controlled seasoning.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Halibut Fish Sandwich with tartar sauce on the side; hold shredded lettuce and pickles upon request.
watchOuts: Peel off crispy fried crust if experiencing active digestive sensitivity
